problems.problem: In the current poster the innermost 'ripple' is a saturated pink disc (shape index 2, bbox [390,925,690,1225]) whose centre (540,1075) sits ~90px BELOW the verified contact point (539.5,985). The contact crop (image 6) proves the heel now meets a soft grey contact shadow at y=985, but the disc hangs under the base like a misplaced sticker: the ripple system no longer converges on the contact point, and the visible pink tint introduces a second red-family note that dilutes the proposition that the cap and label band are the ONLY saturated red. The previous version's error (disc at label height) was over-corrected past the base instead of onto it.
problems.root_cause: Red disc centre anchored 90px below product_base_y and opacity 0.12 still reads as a distinct pink object against #EDEBE7 cardstock.
problems.repair_strategy: Re-centre the concentric set exactly on the contact point (centre 540,985) and cut the red disc to a near-imperceptible convergence tint (opacity ~0.05) or replace it with a grey ring so gravity visibly settles at the base and the label/cap stay the sole red event.

problems.problem: product_height_ratio is 0.4514 (inside the 0.35-0.74 policy, so not a violation) and width ratio only 0.1667: the bottle commands a narrow central column while the ring field and margins carry most of the canvas energy. Against references 3-5, whose hero object owns 60-90% of frame energy, the 'gravity centre' reads as a small object inside a large void; the footer colophon (logo left, subtitle right at y~1348-1384) floats outside the ring geometry and is not anchored to it.
problems.root_cause: Conservative scale choice plus footer copy placed outside the ring system's optical edge.
problems.repair_strategy: Enlarge the product toward ~0.55-0.58 height ratio keeping base <=94% (base y <=1353) and sides inside 5-95%, e.g. height 800, width 224, centre (540, 585) so base lands at 985 unchanged; tighten footer tracking/position so the colophon band aligns to the outer ring's optical margin.

problems.problem: Title '红,自成中心' (bbox [86,128,613,221], tracking 5 applied) is legible and uncropped, but the block still hangs top-left with no optical tie to the ring field, and the CJK comma sits tight after 红. Footer baselines remain mismatched: logo bbox [86,1352,246,1369] bottom 1369 vs subtitle bbox [470,1348,930,1384] bottom 1384 - a 15px baseline split that reads as two stray labels rather than one designed colophon line.
problems.root_cause: Footer layers set by top-edge y instead of a shared baseline; title tracking not tuned for the CJK comma gap.
problems.repair_strategy: Set logo.y and subtitle.y so their rendered baselines coincide (same optical bottom), align logo left edge to the title's x=86 margin and subtitle right edge to the ring field's right optical margin, and raise title tracking slightly (6-8px) so the comma breathes.
